subject: [PATCH v5 12/22] zonefs: convert iomap ops to ->iomap_next()

2026-07-29.patch_summary: This patch converts the iomap operations for the zonefs filesystem to use the new ->iomap_next() callback. The conversion is done using a macro that generates the necessary code, and no functional changes are intended. This change aligns zonefs with the recent updates to the iomap API.
